The Cryptids of Disco Elysium

Every cryptid encountered, rumoured, catalogued or merely whispered about in Disco Elysium, from the reed-mimicking Insulindian Phasmid to the silent song of the Col Do Ma Ma Daqua. Each exhibit pairs the game's own artwork with lore drawn from dialogue with Lena, Morell, Gary and others.

Curatorial Notes

According to Morell, the Cryptozoological Society of Chemnie keeps a list of 4,082 cryptids. About 2,000 are confirmed hoaxes and only two are "confirmed discoveries", both already in a zoo or extinct. The Insulindian Phasmid, documented at the Sea Fortress in March '51, would be the third.

Exhibits marked "described only in dialogue" have no artwork in the game. Rather than invent images, the gallery shows them as specimen plates.

Sources

Lore and quotes come from the community Disco Elysium wikis, retrieved through their MediaWiki APIs: discoelysium.fandom.com and discoelysium.wiki.gg. All artwork © ZA/UM. It is reproduced here at reduced resolution for a non-commercial fan reference, with every image embedded inline as WebP.
